items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: we had a get-together band with Chris... it was a trombone player by the name of Joe Harris. And he had the band in charge and he got the fellas.

ctx.x: The Apophisus Band. And we had a get-together band with Chris. Chris had the band. Well, it was a trombone player by the name of Joe Harris. And he had the band in charge and he got the fellas. I see.
Made up a band. You know this guy Tats? Yeah.
